name: Aussie Gold Hunters
description: Three hard-core crews of gold prospectors take the gamble of a lifetime and battle to strike it big, deep in the wild west of outback Australia. The soaring highs and the crushing lows of the gold season are revealed as the crews pursue their all-important targets - braving brutal heat, punishing conditions, mechanical breakdowns and constant pressure.

videos.title: 3 Men and Gold
videos.overview: In Western Australia's legendary goldfields, three teams of hardcore gold prospectors risk their dreams and futures as they pursue the ultimate golden reward.

videos.title: Mech Disasters and a High-Stakes Gamble
videos.overview: Mechanical problems and a high-stakes gamble threaten to derail the gold season for both the Dirt Dogs and the Gold Gypsies.

videos.title: Uprooting and Salt-Lake Gold
videos.overview: As ‘Dirt Dogs' Vern and Leon are forced to uproot their operation, ‘Gold Gypsies' Chris and Greg face a huge decision. Remote prospectors Henri and Kelli strike salt lake gold.

videos.title: Big Storm and Big Finds
videos.overview: Torrential rain threatens to drown out the season for the Dirt Dogs. Remote prospectors Henri and Kellie hit a hot streak, while the Gold Gypsies strike a once-in-a- lifetime find.

videos.title: All or Nothing and Gold Rich Patch
videos.overview: The ‘Dirt Dogs' fightback comes down to a make or break clean-up, Chris and Greg surf a wave of reef gold, and Henri and Kellie risk life and limb to stay on a hot streak.

videos.title: Targets and Unwanted Guests
videos.overview: Kellie and Henri face poachers and a crippling dry streak, and the 'Dirt Dogs' must break new ground to stay in business. Plus, the 'Gold Gypsies' seek out precious reef gold.

videos.title: Breakdowns and Complications
videos.overview: Kellie and Henri encounter breakdowns and bandits, and a failed plan sees the 'Gold Gypsies' run out of time and options. The 'Dirt Dogs' uncover a huge find - but there's a catch.

videos.title: Digging Deep, Risking Life and Limb
videos.overview: In the final week of gold season, the Dirt Dogs gamble big to hit their tally. Kellie and Henri mount a last-chance hunt for big nuggets, and the Gold Gypsies pursue their goal.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Disaster strikes when a would-be thief crashes The Desert Diggers loader, Shane and Rusty drag their dry blower across the treacherous ground, and Jacqui and Andrew recruit a new prospector to their team.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: A mechanical failure in the mountains of Victoria puts Brent’s son Cayden to the test, fuel theft grinds the Mackies’ operation to a halt, and The Wanderers race to secure a crucial gold deal before week’s end.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Intense heat pushes Jacqui and Andrew to their limits, high winds threaten The Desert Diggers' relocation plans, and Shane and Rusty battle breakdowns and brutal conditions to keep their Fantasy Gully operation alive.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Brent tests the mining skills of his late friend Neville Perry’s sons, a mechanical fault stalls The Wanderers' excavator, and The Mackies make a risky investment on new ground.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Armed with new information, Shane and Russell chase lost gold on Mosquito Creek, disaster strikes the Desert Diggers as they push to double their output, Jacqui and Andrew push deeper into the Palmer River using a new off-road vehicle.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The Poseidon Crew and Neville Perry's sons make their long-awaited return to German Gully. The Desert Diggers wade through mud for a major payday, while Sheryl and Simon battle breakdowns to hit their gold target.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: The Desert Diggers secure a season-changing deal, gambling on untested ground. The Poseidon Crew expand operations at German Gully to find big gold, and intense summer heat pushes The Wanderers to the brink.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: As time runs out, the Poseidon Crew call in a trusted ally. The Mackies detonate explosives to obliterate impenetrable rock, while Jacqui, and Andrew gamble everything, racing against the relentless wet season to strike gold before disaster hits.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The Poseidon Crew unearth a once in a lifetime nugget at Catto's Paddock. Jacqui Buzetti braves the wild Northern Territory with a new mining partner.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Shane and Rusty position themselves for a once-in-a-lifetime deal, newcomers the Gold Drifters hunt for a long lost gold field, and Sheryl and Simon face the biggest decision of their mining careers.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Sheryl and Simon gamble everything on a move to new ground with massive potential. Poseidon Crew look to double their gold - mining two claims, and Shane and Rusty risk life and limb to pull off a lucrative deal.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Jacqui and Kyle brave crocodile country for Northern Territory gold. Brad McGhie faces a multimillion-dollar decision. Newcomers the Gold Drifters go high-tech in their hunt for gold.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Storms hammer the Poseidon Crew as they chase monster nuggets in Victoria. In the Northern Territory, a historic artefact puts Jacqui and Kyle on the gold, while Shane and Rusty move fast to flip a valuable outback lease.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: A man down and battling mechanical breakdowns, Brent and Cayden fight to keep German Gully alive. Sheryl and Simon make a grave discovery on their new lease. Jacqui and Kyle race the Northern Territory's looming wet season in a desperate push for gold.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: With permit issues shutting down their lease, the Desert Diggers have one week to prove new ground. The Gold Drifters go back to basics as they hunt for gold, and Jacqui and Kyle's exploration skills are tested in new territory.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: The Poseidon Crew chase a dream hunting for gold in the mountains of Tasmania. Shane calls in a lifelong friend to help secure the sale of his lease, and the Desert Diggers' hunt for ground intensifies.
